tier_1_blockers.description: Per-session model persistence + model indicator in status bar
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.1 (verbatim Chinese requirement). Root cause: updateSessionModelMode (storage.ts:864-882) writes Zustand only, no MMKV persistence. Fix shape: mirror permission-mode plumbing (storage.ts:834-862, persistence.ts:191-206). Add model chip to AgentInput.tsx footer immediately left of permission badge (line 877-902).
tier_1_blockers.affects: core UX — session state loss on re-entry

tier_1_blockers.description: 1M-context Claude models — context-usage display broken (shows 0% left)
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.2. Root cause: AgentInput.tsx:85 hardcoded MAX_CONTEXT_SIZE=190000 makes 1M models clamp to 0%. Fix: per-model context-window lookup driven by session.modelMode / session.metadata.currentModelCode.
tier_1_blockers.affects: status bar accuracy for all 1M-context models

tier_1_blockers.description: Right-side Bash popup — command text overflows popup width
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.3. Relevant files: SidebarBashView.tsx:43-59, CommandView.tsx:33-90 (uses flexWrap:wrap + flex:1 which defeats the outer horizontal ScrollView). Dev must reproduce and decide remedy (remove flexWrap / tighten maxWidth / constrain flex:1).

tier_1_blockers.description: Top bar — happy logo and avatar positions are hardcoded, not responsive
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.4. Relevant files: Header.tsx:210-235 (static layout.headerMaxWidth), RightSidebar.tsx:11 (fixed SIDEBAR_WIDTH=450), MainView.tsx:29-99 (no awareness of right sidebar state). Default assumption B: fix header maxWidth / centerContainer reflow, not logo/avatar absolute positioning.
tier_1_blockers.affects: entire top-bar layout across all viewports and sidebar states

tier_1_blockers.description: Top bar / layout — second non-adaptive case (same class as §5.4)
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.5. Continuation of §5.4 — must be resolved by the same fix. Treat as a verification case for §5.4's remedy.

tier_1_blockers.description: Codex tool-call popup — not aligned with Claude Code popup redesign
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.6. CodexBashView.tsx (lines 18-102) branches on parsed_cmd type and uses its own primitives (padding 12, surfaceHigh bg, borderRadius 8) instead of unifying through BashView/CommandView. Fix shape: route Codex through shared primitives.
tier_1_blockers.affects: Codex flavor popup parity with Claude Code

tier_1_blockers.description: Codex tool-call popup — Description field echoes raw command instead of human-readable summary
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.7. CodexBashView.tsx derives 'description' from parsed_cmd type via i18n keys, but when parsed_cmd is unknown/missing the fallback echoes the raw /bin/bash -lc string into both Description and Input Parameters.description. Fix: separate sources, hide or synthesize short description when none provided.

tier_1_blockers.description: Markdown tables overflow width — port fix from happy prod
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.8. User explicitly requires porting the production table-overflow wrapper (likely horizontally-scrollable <table> wrapper around MarkdownView). Dev MUST locate production treatment and replicate — not reinvent.

tier_1_blockers.description: Stop-hook feedback must not be shown to the user
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.9. Stop-hook output (e.g., 'SPEC COVERAGE ENFORCEMENT: spec-verify.py reports < 100% coverage') is rendering in the user-facing conversation. Must be suppressed for user view, retained in dev telemetry only.

tier_1_blockers.description: Long background-task disconnect causes out-of-order delivery on reconnect
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.10. On disconnect after long background task, happy's reconnect (triggered by next user message) delivers Claude's background-task reply BEFORE the reply to the new user message. Root cause: happy transport/relay queue ordering. Fix: proactive reconnect + causal ordering in delivery queue.
tier_1_blockers.affects: message ordering reliability — not a UI bug, backend transport

tier_1_blockers.description: Detail panel — long file path overflows the header
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.11. Detail panel header displays full file_path verbatim without truncation/wrap/scroll. Fix: middle ellipsis, wrap, or horizontal scroll with accessible full-path (tooltip/copy).

tier_1_blockers.description: Attachment tray — width inconsistency + silent failure on oversize upload
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.12. Two bugs: (1) file vs image thumbnails use different padding/gutter; (2) oversize uploads fail silently with no user-visible error. Fix: shared attachment layout primitive + visible error state (toast/inline/badge).

tier_1_blockers.description: Codex subagent tasks are not displayed
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.13. Codex spawn_agent / send_input / wait_agent / resume_agent / close_agent produce no UI card at all. Must render equivalent to Claude Code's Agent tool: header with subagent name/status, inline card + detail panel. Resolves as part of §5.15.

tier_1_blockers.description: Codex multi-file edit — no right-sidebar rendering
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.14. Codex apply_patch spanning multiple files produces no right-sidebar detail view. Must parallel Claude Code's multi-file edit panel with per-file diff navigation. Resolves as part of §5.15.

tier_1_blockers.description: Codex tool coverage — only exec_command renders; all other Codex tools invisible
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.15. Four categories of Codex tools (A Web/realtime, B Local-exec/engineering, C Subagent/delegation, D Tool-suggest/plugin) produce no UI cards except functions.exec_command. Must render inline card + detail panel for EVERY tool in the four categories. Aligns with §5.6/§5.13/§5.14/§5.18.

tier_1_blockers.description: Inline LaTeX math is not rendered
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.16. `$...$` renders as raw source instead of typeset math. LatexRenderer.tsx and parseMarkdown.ts exist — fix is likely activation/delimiter-recognition gap, not a missing renderer.

tier_1_blockers.description: Several markdown primitives are not rendered (headings, strikethrough, tasks, nested lists, blockquotes, HTML/escape)
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.17. H1/H2/H3 headings, ~~strikethrough~~, - [x] task lists, nested unordered lists, ordered lists, > blockquote, nested >> blockquote, <kbd>...</kbd>, <entities> all render as raw source. Bold/italic/code/links DO work — must not regress.
tier_1_blockers.affects: all MarkdownView surfaces — same pipeline as §5.16

tier_1_blockers.description: CronList tool — inline card too verbose; move detail to sidebar
tier_1_blockers.evidence: User spec §5.18. Current: full INPUT/OUTPUT block inline. Target: compact header + one summary line inline (like Bash/subagent pattern); move current verbose rendering to right-side sidebar only. Establishes the general rule for tool cards that §5.15 must also follow.

Section 1 of the spec already contains thorough background exploration with exact file paths and line numbers — Dev should implement directly from those pointers rather than re-exploring.
